rationale: Sharon's work building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai could benefit from deep materials science expertise, particularly as agentic AI expands into biotech and adjacent sectors where advanced materials play a critical role. Saori's background as a researcher at Resonac, a leader in semiconductor and functional materials, represents the domain knowledge that AI infrastructure companies often need to validate use cases in hard-tech verticals.
intro_message: Saori Miura, meet Sharon — Sharon builds AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai and your materials science expertise at Resonac could help them understand how agentic systems apply in semiconductor and materials workflows.
